title: Analytics — instructor and platform learning aggregates
description: Instructor+ analytics for belajar-with-rahmanef.com: per-materi completion counts, course-completion (badge) count, tenant member count, quiz attempt/pass stats per course, and — 0.3.0 — READER counts: the per-course drop-off funnel and the community's weekly pulse. Aggregates are derived on read over shared tables with documented bounded takes (no bare .collect(), P1) and carry no user identifiers. ONE write: MateriViewRecorder → insight/views:recordView, member-only and idempotent per member per materi per WIB day. EVERY reader number counts LOGGED-IN MEMBERS ONLY — anonymous reads are invisible — and MembersOnlyNote ships that caveat with the numbers. No routes: the Kelola › Statistik tab mounts TenantPulseView + CourseAnalyticsView (which leads with CourseFunnelView). 0.2.0: module grouping dropped (DECISIONS #37). 0.4.0: admin-only platform inventory, selected-period activity, WIB daily trends and filterable/exportable community/course/materi/quiz tables. Count exactness and bounded-source completeness ship alongside data; no anonymous website traffic. First-party visitor analytics is a separate admin view with 7/30-day page-view/session/CTA trends, acquisition/device rankings and masked sessions; local approximate country/city GeoIP with honest unknowns and source attribution, no historical reconstruction.
